description.narrative: inclusion and non-discrimination of people with disabilities in line with national strategies(SNDEI, SN-3PH) and the Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (CRPD) through: a.) capacity building of government and civil society at central and local levels; b.) improving access of people with disabilities to services in the areas of health, education and vocational training
